final.summary: One comparable prior decision judged the code not exploitable for a reason specific to it. Another retrieved issue is a performance fix and is not a security precedent.

precedents.title: Shell command built from upload filename in the archived service
precedents.rationale: Reviewers found the input constrained before use.
precedents.quote: Not exploitable: uploads are renamed to a server-generated UUID before convert_upload sees them.

caveats: Issue 4373 matched on vocabulary only; it is a performance issue.
